brief: Brackets for my car's roof bars that hold my kayak for a motorway drive to the coast.

requirements.evidence: 2-cell base with L-bracket accessory shows bracket shape only; no roof-bar clamp interface verified and car fit not checked by configurator
No kayak cradle, hull support, straps or tie-downs in catalog; single L-bracket does not form kayak carrier
Configurator checks fit/collisions only, not strength, load ratings, vibration, wind load or road safety; parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material. Cannot certify motorway use.
requirements.requirement: Safe for motorway drive to the coast

finish.summary: Built a 2-cell demonstrator with L-bracket, capped and locked, mesh clear. It does not attach to roof bars, does not carry a kayak, and is not safe or certified for motorway use — do not use it to carry a kayak on a car.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
